response.rationale: HP is 2/11 on wave 1 with a baby alien close. Armor +1 is the survival pick the unlock needs. Harvesting is only 1 plan point ahead, so the gap is small.
Cactus Mace is on-plan melee, scores 22, and affordable at 23 of 59 gold. With Rock it makes 2 Primitive for +3 max HP, which helps survival at 2/11 HP. Fist is cheaper but weaker.

Ghost Axe is the top-scored melee option at exactly our 23 gold: 12 base damage plus kill-stacking % damage, which helps clear waves at 2/11 HP. Terrified Onion adds +speed, the wrong way for chal_slow.
Torch (14g) fits the any-type plan and adds a third Primitive piece with rock and cacti club, giving +6 max HP. Shuriken is ranged and only ties on score, so the cheaper melee piece wins.
Crit chance +3 is the only option the plan weights (4.5) and the advisor scores (4.5). Elemental, engineering and luck score 0. Speed is not offered here, so this follows the plan.

Ugly Tooth gives -3 stat_speed and remove_speed, both on the chal_slow goal list. The board already holds 6 weapons, so Cactus Mace has no slot and no combine (only one owned). Gold 53 covers only one item.

No blunt weapon or speed-negative item offered; the board is full at 6 weapons and I hold one cacti club and one torch, so neither buy would combine. Reroll to seek set_blunt or couch/speed items with 126 gold.
Speed +6 moves away from the chal_slow target (-13 to -20) and scores -24. Regen is at -1, so +3 HP regen adds survival. Range and lifesteal are neutral to the plan.
Plan weights stat_ranged_damage highest (8.0) and advisor scores it 8, the top offer. Range and lifesteal score 0; crit is 7.5 and secondary. No speed-reducing option is offered.
Speed +6 runs against chal_slow (needs stat_speed -20). Crit +3 matches the plan's top weight (4.5) and scores above dodge (4.0) and is unweighted HP regen. Survival is fine at 45/51.
Ball And Chain gives stat_speed -3 (speed is -13, target -20), fits the plan's item bonus, and is affordable at 151 of 462 gold. Cacti Mace can't join the board: 6 weapons already and no combine.
Warrior Helmet affordable (161 of 179 gold). Its -5 speed takes stat_speed from -16 to -21, past the chal_slow target of -20, and it adds armor and max HP that the plan weights.
Target done and harvesting 44 is past the cap. Max HP is only 57 at wave 10 with 330 gold banked. Shift weight to survival (max_hp, armor, dodge) and spend surplus.

Ghost Axe scores 105 on the advisor, the top offer by far. It adds a second Ethereal piece for dodge and is affordable at 88 of 323 gold. Weapon count is at the 6 cap, so the buy may need a combine or a sell to fit.
Acid is the only option with a meaningful plan score (18). It adds +8 max HP, which the plan weights, and 273 gold covers its 147 price. Its -2 dodge is a minor cost. Other options score 0 or -1.
Speed +6 would push stat_speed from -17 toward -11, away from the -20 target and the plan's -12 weight. Lifesteal +2 adds sustain while the run stays on the slow build.
Max HP +3 has the top advisor score (8) and matches the plan's stat_max_hp weight of 8. HP is 52/75, so extra max HP helps survival while running chal_slow. Melee and regen score 0.

Acid is the top-scored offer (+8 max HP fits plan weight 8, survival matters at 50/74 HP) and is affordable at 272 gold. Brick would not combine on a full 6-weapon board; Beanie gives +4 speed, working against the -20 speed target.
Metal Plate fits plan: +2 armor (armor weight 7) for 115 of 226 gold. Costs -3% percent damage, which is the main downside. Other offers are off-plan weapons scoring -1.
Metal Plate is the only offer the plan scores positively (10.1). It adds armor (plan weight 7) at a small percent-damage cost. Javelin, lance and baby score -1 or 0 and don't help the slow target.
Gentle Alien scores highest on plan weights (+5 percent damage, +2 max HP) and fits 197 gold. Metal Plate's -3 percent damage hurts more than its armor helps. Extra enemies is a risk at 66/87 HP.
Barricade is affordable (219 of 401 gold), is on the plan's item_bonus list at 7.5, and gives stat_speed -5 toward the chal_slow goal plus armor for survival. Top advisor score.
